units.source_text: “可是，真要是想起来，那青年的心思也并非不能理解。

en.t: But when you really think about it, the young man's feelings were not impossible to understand.

units.source_text: 农民呐，增加土地，就意味着增加工作量……

en.t: For farmers, gaining more land simply means having more work to do...

units.source_text: 结果，不只是劳苦，最终能到手的，只有更加辛苦的可能性……

en.t: In the end, what they get is not just hardship, but only the possibility of even harder labor...

units.source_text: 其实，农民嘛，只要米和山芋有收获，还算不错呢。

en.t: Still, for farmers, as long as they can harvest rice and yams, things are not so bad.

units.source_text: 与此相比，这清沙的活儿呐，简直就像在冥河河滩上堆石头——白费劲！”

en.t: Compared with that, this work of clearing sand is just like piling stones on the banks of the River Styx, completely futile!"
